title: 2000 Upper Deck Legends Defining Moments #DM9 Kurt Warner St. Louis Rams Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2000 Upper Deck Legends Kurt Warner #DM9 football card featuring the player as a member of the St. Louis Rams in the National Football League (NFL). This card is part of the Defining Moments parallel/variety and is not autographed. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Upper Deck for the 2000 season.
